scope: Benchmark-only generator. No recognition, score, expected identity or source dependent rules.
selection: Preserve original Round21 selected40 identities,20 filler IDs and5 variants each,case IDs,seeds and synthetic variant numbers. No replacement or resampling.

modes.acroform_native: Valid canonical field tree and widgets: synthetic text/date/numeric/checkbox values,save,reopen,verify logical values,appearance and page widgets. Preserve interactive fields.
modes.static_overlay: No valid AcroForm: deterministic synthetic text in raster-verified blank rectangles. All existing words,ink,lines,headers,code,entity and year remain protected. Search pages in original order; same page count and geometry. No appended page,marginal canvas extension,rescaling or title rewriting.
modes.safe_fallback: Malformed,unsupported or unsavable AcroForm on a valid renderable PDF: preserve original bytes,flatten only existing widget appearances in output,apply the identical static policy,record fallback_from_acroform=true and error. No field-tree guessing or XML/PDF structure repair.

static_parameters.partial_overlay: All7 predefined values attempted in order; only independently safe fitting values are written. At least1 fully persisted value required,actual count reported. No truncation,overlap,removal or invisible/white text.

seed: Use exact original V6 case seed and variant; row and x grid order seeded deterministically. Original successful outputs remain immutable in round21/work.

validation.file: Atomic write,nonempty<=20MiB,read-back SHA,reopen,no encryption,same1..100pages and geometry
validation.values: AcroForm updated logical /V equals reopened widget values with /AP /N. Static at least1 exact full synthetic string extracted and rendered.
validation.template: Original text retained. Render before/after144DPI; outside updated widget/overlay rectangles (2pointpadding),fraction of pixels differing by>8 gray units <=0.0001. Reject any larger change,never credit integrity failures.
validation.external: No newly introduced active URI,JavaScript,Launch,GoToR,SubmitForm,ImportData or external-file target; original official PDF references may remain inert and unchanged.
validation.parser: Run local application extraction safety parser without recognition. Keep limits and readable failures.
validation.cleanup: In-memory generator; atomic writer uses same output folder. No external files/network. Preserve completed evidence and failures; temporary partial removed only after successful atomic replace.

freeze: Policy fixed before aggregate regeneration and before any V6 predictions; no policy/generator/selection/seed/label changes after first V6 result.
